title: Localize the hardcoded '…yos' decorative chip text in IntroMishnaIllustration
why: The sibling chip on the same illustration correctly resolves via AppLocalizations (introMishnaReviewChip: 'Review…' EN / 'חזרה…' HE), but this second floating chip is a literal, unlocalized Latin-script fragment rendered unconditionally regardless of locale. In Hebrew locale a user sees a stray Latin '…yos' fragment floating over an otherwise fully-Hebrew first-run screen. No test in app_intro_screen_l1_test.dart's dedicated l10n-leak regression group — whose stated purpose is guarding this exact screen against exactly this class of bug — catches it, because that group checks a different text element on the same page.
recommendation: Add an ARB key for the fragment with a real Hebrew value (or drop it for HE if the design intent doesn't survive translation), and extend app_intro_screen_l1_test.dart's Hebrew l10n group to assert on it.
acceptance_criteria: make arb-parity and flutter analyze stay clean after adding the key
app_intro_screen_l1_test.dart's 'l10n — Hebrew locale renders Hebrew, not English literals' group gains an assertion that the English fragment does not appear in Locale('he')
